# Qryptonics

> Quantum systems engineering. Post-quantum cryptographic
> migration, quantum optimization, quantum machine learning, and hybrid
> quantum-classical HPC.

Qryptonics helps organisations answer two questions: which cryptographic
algorithms their systems can still trust in ten years, and which of their
operational problems belong on quantum or hybrid hardware now.

## Pages

- [Home](https://qryptonics.com/): Practices, interactive quantum circuit figures, sectors served.
- [Development](https://qryptonics.com/development.html): Quantum software engineering, post-quantum cryptographic implementation (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA), enterprise applications, data engineering, HPC.
- [Services](https://qryptonics.com/services.html): Post-quantum readiness assessment, cryptographic bill of materials, penetration testing, ISO management system readiness and certification through accredited partners (27001, 42001, 9001, 22301 and more), SAMA and PDPL compliance, source code review, technical due diligence, training.
- [PQC solutions](https://qryptonics.com/pqc-solutions.html): Post-quantum cryptography as a managed solution (page in preparation).
- [Software solutions](https://qryptonics.com/software-solutions.html): Quantum, hybrid and classical software, built and handed over (page in preparation).
- [Simulator](https://qryptonics.com/simulator.html): Free browser-based quantum simulator. Density-matrix circuit simulation with T1/T2 decoherence, quantum network entanglement distribution over fibre, and distributed quantum computing across QPUs. No account, nothing uploaded.
- [Q-Majlis](https://qryptonics.com/community.html): A free, global quantum computing community. Tracks in foundations, optimization and machine learning, post-quantum cryptography, and quantum networks.
- [Whitepaper](https://qryptonics.com/whitepaper.html): Working paper on cryptographic inventory before post-quantum migration.
- [Docs](https://qryptonics.com/docs.html): How the quantum simulator computes its results — density-matrix noise, optical loss budgets, coupling maps, limits.
- [Research](https://qryptonics.com/research.html): Open research questions in quantum optimization, QML under realistic data, PQC engineering, and hybrid runtimes.
- [Blog](https://qryptonics.com/blog.html): Engineering notes on quantum networks, post-quantum migration and optimization.
- [Fingerprints, PUFs and quantum PUFs](https://qryptonics.com/blog/fingerprinting-pufs-and-quantum-pufs.html): How device fingerprinting and physical unclonable functions work, how they are attacked, what quantum PUFs improve, and the open problems.
- [Full-stack quantum networks](https://qryptonics.com/blog/full-stack-quantum-networks.html): Why layered quantum network stacks matter, what they make possible, and the open problems before deployment.
- [About](https://qryptonics.com/about.html): Who we are and how we work.
- [Get in touch](https://qryptonics.com/contact.html): WhatsApp and email.
- [Security](https://qryptonics.com/security.html): Vulnerability disclosure policy and scope.

## Facts

- Works with clients internationally, remote-first.
- Specialises in NIST post-quantum standards FIPS 203, 204 and 205.
- Publishes a free, dependency-free quantum simulator that runs entirely client-side.
- Contact: hello@qryptonics.com
